visual_action: A montage of U.S. military hardware in action, set at night and during the day. The video shows a B-1 Lancer bomber on a tarmac, crew boarding, and the plane taking off with afterburners lit. It includes several clips of a B-2 Spirit stealth bomber flying through clouds. There is also footage of an F-35 fighter jet landing on an aircraft carrier. The montage features a warship launching missiles and firing a large deck gun. Interspersed are several clips of black-and-white thermal imaging or aerial footage showing explosions and targets, some of which are overlaid with the text "UNCLASSIFIED". The video concludes with several black-and-white shots of the White House, including one with Marine One landing, with the text "THE WHITE HOUSE" overlaid.
